entities.name: Service type information element
entities.description: Information element that specifies the purpose of the service request procedure through encoded service type values.

entities.name: Service type IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier field that identifies the Service type IE.

entities.name: Service type value
entities.description: Field containing the encoded service type value indicating the purpose of the service request procedure.

entities.name: Mobile originating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback
entities.description: Service type condition indicating mobile originating circuit-switched fallback.

entities.name: Mobile terminating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback
entities.description: Service type condition indicating mobile terminating circuit-switched fallback.

entities.name: Mobile originating CS fallback emergency call or 1xCS fallback emergency call
entities.description: Service type condition indicating mobile originating circuit-switched fallback emergency call.

entities.name: Packet services via S1
entities.description: Service type condition indicating packet services via S1 interface.

relations.description: Service type IE contains the IEI identifier field.
Service type IE contains the service type value field.
Service type value field is guarded by mobile originating CS fallback condition when bits 4-1 are 0000.
Service type value field is guarded by mobile terminating CS fallback condition when bits 4-1 are 0001.
Service type value field is guarded by mobile originating CS fallback emergency call condition when bits 4-1 are 0010.
Service type value field is guarded by packet services via S1 condition when bits 4-1 are 1000.
